DILG Republic of thc Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Building, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT MR. JACOB KOSHY Chairman & Presiding Officer Cebu City Development Council Social Development Sectoral Committee City of Cebu Dear Presiding Officer Koshy: DILG Legal opinion No. 16 S. 2016 03 MAR 2016 This refers to Cebu City Development Council-Social Development Sectoral Committee Resolution No. 07-0709, s. 2015 inquiring from this Department why a fire truck cannot be considered a calamity related equipment pursuant to Item 3.1.7 of DILG-DBM Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2011-I, dated 13 April 2011 (hereinafter, the "JMC"). Item 3.1.7 of the JMC, as stated, authorizes the purchase or repair of appropriate calamity-related rescue operations equipment, and proceeds to enumerate/provide exalnples of said equipment, viz: "3.0 PROJECTS COVERED The 20% of the IRA intended for development projects may be utilized for the following priority programs and projects: 3.1 SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT xxx 3.1.7 Purchase or repair of appropriate calamity-related rescue operations equipment such as inflatable boats, breathing apparatus, extraction tools, safe line rescue ropes, fire extinguishers, chainsaws, taro (2) way handheld radios and the like;" Pursuant to the basic statutory construction principle of ejusdem generis, where a general word or phrase follows an enumeration of particular and specific words of the same class,

the general word or phrase is to be construed to include or to be restricted to things akin to or resembling, or of the same kind or class as, those specifically mentionedl. As such, the phrase "and the like" should be construed to include or to be restricted to things akin to or resembling, or of the same kind or class as, those calamity-related rescue equipment enumerated in Item 3.1.7 of the JMC. In addition to the application of the principle of ejusdem generis, Section 5.02 of the JMC clearly intends the exclusion of items for personal services and those mentioned under Item 4.0 thereof, which expressly include "purchase of motor vehicles" from among the enumeration, viz: "4.0 EXPENDITURE ITEMS NOT COVERED The following expense items that are not related Io and/or connected with the implementation of development projects, programs and activities shall not be paid out of the 20% development fund: 4.1 4.2 4.3 4.4 4.5 4.6 4.7 Administrative expenses such as cash gifts, bonuses, food allowance, medical assistance, uniforms, supplies, meetings, communication, water and light, petroleum products and the like; Salaries, zvages or overtime pay; Travelling expenses, whether domestic or foreign; Registration or participation fees in [raining, seminars, conferences or conventions; Construction, repair or refinishing of administrative offices; Purchase of administrative office furniture, fixtures, equipment or appliances; and Purchase, maintenance or repair of motor vehicles or motor cyles. "[Emphasis supplied] Liwag vs. Happy Glen Loop Homeowners Association, Inc. (G.R. No. 189755. July a, 2012) 5.0 RESPONSIBILITY OF THE LOCAL CHIEF EXECUTIVE It is the responsibility of every Provincial Governor, City and Municipal Mayor and Punong Barangay to ensure that the 20% of the IRA is optimally utilized to help achieve desirable socio-economic development projects and environmental outcomes. appropriations for development projects shall not include items for personal services and those mentioned in the immediately preceding Item No. 4 hereof. Further, all concerned local chief executives are hereby reminded that utilizing such fund, whether willfully or through negligence, for any purpose beyond those expressly prescribed by law or public policy shall be subject to the sanctions provided under the Local Government Code and such other applicable laws. [Emphasis and underscoring ours)

In view thereof, we regret to inform you that the 20% local development fund cannot be utilized for purchase of trucks and other motor vehicles, unless particularly identified/authorized under Item 3.0 of the JMC. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, A TEREA. Undersecretary ADERO DIR. RENE K. BURDEOS Regional Director DILG Region VII, Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City DR. OSCAR S.
